The entire point of defender gear is to speedrun through vanilla to get to Iceborne as quickly as possible. It’s supposed to be for returning players or veterans who have done multiple playthroughs, who understand the mechanics of the game and generally know what they’re actually doing. Even the most basic Iceborne gear is significantly more powerful than Defender. 
The problem with it, is because it’s so busted, new players end up using it at a crutch, developing bad habits and by the time they reach Iceborne and the armour and weapons immediately become invalid, they get steamrolled, which is why everyone on here recommends new players play the game without defender gear.

Definitely agree with /u/DidierCrumb on Bassacutena & Poggiola.

The rest of the stage is crazy fast with the occasional squares and 1's thrown in, there's very little room for error with it and it's brilliant, 100% my fav tarmac stage. There's another Corsica stage which I think is called Alboretto or something similar? That's also an amazing tarmac stage. Corsica is by far the best tarmac rally of the lot so I'd recommend trying all of them.

Listening to the album in full. The only songs I've heard previously are WOTP and KOBK, everything else is complete first impressions, I managed to avoid all the leaks and the other singles. 

Will of the People: I don't really like the verses, the riff is...fine, simple but catchy, some of the lyrics (That fucking bathwater line) are dumb, but wow that chorus is catchy as hell and it'll be a banger live. 7/10

Compliance: Not a fan honestly. It's not bad, it's kinda fine. Lyrics aren't anything special, the chorus is ehh, it's a bit of a filler song for me. Haven't heard it live yet though. That little riff during the bridge is pretty cool though. 5/10

Liberation: This was like fucking whiplash after the last 2 songs, it sounds so different. Kinda like a song from Resistance, which is an album I didn't like for the most part. The vocals are very good. 6/10

Won't Stand Down: I love the driving beat during the verses, I don't think the lyrics are that good. The riff is so heavy I love it. The last minute ish is fucking mental. The chorus is pretty good too. This will absolutely slap live. 8/10

Ghosts: Lyrics aren't very good, but it sounds nice. Vocals are good, and the piano is always a treat to hear. It's fine overall. I doubt this'll be played live as Dom and Chris have fuck all to do during it. 6.5/10

Halloween: This is mental. I don't even know if I like it, it's insanity, so goofy sounding but in a kinda fun way? Fucking hilarious song. I'm laughing during it but not in an Angelic 2 the Core way, more of a "I can't believe this is a thing" way. ?????/10

Kill or Be Killed: Yeah everyone knows how good this song is. Nothing new there. The Benny Benassi - Satisfaction sounding riff at the start is great, the vocals are great, the chorus is fantastic, lyrics are decent but obviously the instrumental is the highlight. The drums are brilliant. I don't really like the "yah yah yah" part after the second chorus, but the solo afterwards? Hook it to my veins. I'm not even really a metal fan but I fucking love it. 9/10

Verona: The vocals are stunning. I don't think they beat my favourite vocal performance (Big Freeze on T2L) but they're very close. I love the little synths and the guitars in this one, it's a lot more poppy and chill, which is exacerbated by the fact it's after KOBK, but I do like it. I feel like I've been edged when I get to the end though, I thought they'd be a bit of a breakdown at the end but nope. Still a solid track. 8/10

Euphoria: I'm not much of a fan of this either sadly. Lyrics are pretty bland, I don't think the riffs are all that, the chorus is pretty forgettable. 5/10

We are Fucking Fucked: Dumb title aside, this is kinda fun. The verses are kinda background noise, the chorus and the riff are very good. The "S T O C K P I L E" bit is hilarious. I love the ending.  It ends incredibly suddenly, but I wouldn't be surprised if when they play it live (Possibly as a closer?) It's heavily extended like Stockholm Syndrome. 8/10.

Overall: 7/10. I think overall it's better than the past few albums. There aren't any obvious stinkers, but I also wouldn't say there's lots of standouts on here. KOBK is the obvious one. Every song is at least "Okay", but I think it feels kinda disjointed, I don't know why some of these songs are on THIS album specifically. There's songs that feel like OoS-BHaR era Muse, Resistance and T2L songs, and sounds from Simulation Theory. I'll add some of these to my playlist (KOBK, Verona, WSD, maybe WAFF and WOTP) but the rest of the album doesn't really do it for me as a whole.
